-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check. Probes Slack OAuth credentials and API reachability via auth.test.

list-channels.name: list-channels
list-channels.description: List channels. Returns curated rows { id, name, isPrivate, isArchived, isMember, numMembers, topic, purpose, created } + nextCursor. Params: types? (CSV public_channel|private_channel|mpim|im), limit (1-1000, def 100), cursor, excludeArchived (def true), fields?, includeRaw.

params.types: Comma-separated channel types from public_channel, private_channel, mpim, im. Default: public_channel,private_channel.
params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 1000, default 100.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Slack channel objects. Default false.

get-channel.name: get-channel
get-channel.description: Get a single channel. Returns { id, name, isPrivate, isArchived, isMember, numMembers, topic, purpose, created, creator, isGeneral, isShared } + extras. Params: channelId, fields?, includeRaw.

params.channelId: Slack channel id (C... / G... / D... / M...).
params.includeRaw: Return raw Slack channel object. Default false.

create-channel.name: create-channel
create-channel.description: Create a channel. Slack normalizes the name (lowercase, no spaces, only [a-z0-9_-], ≤80). Returns the curated channel + ActionBadge('created'). Not retryable. Params: name, isPrivate? (def false), topic?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.name: Channel name (lowercase, ≤80 chars, only letters/digits/underscore/hyphen).
params.topic: Optional channel topic, set after creation.
params.fields: Override default whitelist on the returned channel.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Slack channel object. Default false.

archive-channel.name: archive-channel
archive-channel.description: Archive a channel (read-only afterwards). Returns { id, name } from a follow-up info call. Not retryable. Params: channelId.

join-channel.name: join-channel
join-channel.description: Join a public channel. Returns the curated channel. Idempotent (already_in_channel raises BUSINESS_RULE). Params: channelId.

invite-to-channel.name: invite-to-channel
invite-to-channel.description: Invite users to a channel. Returns { channel, invitedUserIds, alreadyInChannel? }. Not retryable. Params: channelId, userIds[].

params.userIds: Slack user ids (U... / W...) to invite.

leave-channel.name: leave-channel
leave-channel.description: Leave a public or private channel. Returns { channelId, notInChannel }. Not retryable. Params: channelId.

list-channel-members.name: list-channel-members
list-channel-members.description: List user ids that are members of a channel. Returns { channelId, members: string[], nextCursor, hasMore }. Retryable. Use list-users + lookup if you need profile info. Params: channelId, limit (1-1000, def 200), cursor?.

open-dm.name: open-dm
open-dm.description: Open or fetch a direct conversation. Single user → IM (D...); multiple → MPIM (M...). Idempotent (re-opens existing channel). Returns curated channel. Params: users[] (1+ U.../W... ids), returnIm (def true).

params.users: Array of Slack user ids. 1 user → IM. 2-8 users → MPIM.
params.returnIm: Return full channel object (def true). When false only id is returned.

rename-channel.name: rename-channel
rename-channel.description: Rename a channel. Name must be ≤80 chars, lowercase, no spaces/periods (Slack normalizes). Returns curated channel. Not retryable. Params: channelId, name.

params.name: New name. Slack lowercases and strips invalid chars automatically.

set-channel-purpose.name: set-channel-purpose
set-channel-purpose.description: Set the purpose of a channel (long-form description shown in details). Max 250 chars. Returns { channelId, purpose }. Not retryable. Params: channelId, purpose.

set-channel-topic.name: set-channel-topic
set-channel-topic.description: Set the topic of a channel (short description in the channel header). Max 250 chars. Returns { channelId, topic }. Not retryable. Params: channelId, topic.

kick-from-channel.name: kick-from-channel
kick-from-channel.description: Remove a user from a channel. Requires admin or channel owner permissions. Returns { channelId, userId, kicked: true }. Not retryable. Params: channelId, userId.

unarchive-channel.name: unarchive-channel
unarchive-channel.description: Unarchive a previously archived channel. Returns curated channel. Not retryable. Params: channelId.

mark-channel-read.name: mark-channel-read
mark-channel-read.description: Mark all messages in a channel up to and including `timestamp` as read for the authed user. Returns { channelId, timestamp, marked: true }. Idempotent. Params: channelId, timestamp.

params.timestamp: Message ts as the read cursor ("1234567890.123456").

send-message.name: send-message
send-message.description: Post a message to a channel, DM, or as a top-level message. Returns { ts, channel, message, permalink }. Not retryable (no idempotency key — duplicate messages on retry). Params: channel, text, blocks? (JSON), threadTs?, unfurlLinks (def true), unfurlMedia (def true).

params.channel: Channel id (C... / G... / D... / M...) or user id (U... for DM).
params.text: Plain text body. Required even when blocks are provided (used as fallback).
params.blocks: Optional Slack Block Kit JSON string (will be parsed).
params.threadTs: Parent message ts to post as a thread reply. Use send-thread-reply for the canonical thread API.
params.unfurlLinks: Unfurl links in the message. Default true.
params.unfurlMedia: Unfurl media in the message. Default true.

send-thread-reply.name: send-thread-reply
send-thread-reply.description: Reply inside a Slack thread. Returns { ts, channel, threadTs, broadcast, message }. Not retryable (no idempotency key). Params: channel, threadTs, text, blocks? (JSON), broadcast (def false).

params.channel: Channel id where the parent message lives.
params.blocks: Optional Slack Block Kit JSON string.
params.broadcast: Also broadcast the reply to the channel. Default false.

list-messages.name: list-messages
list-messages.description: List messages from a channel or thread (passes threadTs to fetch replies). Returns curated rows { ts, channel, user, text, threadTs, replyCount, reactions, permalink, createdAt } + nextCursor + isThread. Params: channel, threadTs?, limit (1-200, def 50), cursor, oldest, latest, inclusive, fields?, includeRaw.

params.channel: Slack channel id (C... / G... / D... / M...).
params.threadTs: Parent message ts to fetch thread replies. Format 1234567890.123456.
params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 200, default 50.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Slack message objects. Default false.

update-message.name: update-message
update-message.description: Edit an existing message. The token user must be the author. Returns { ts, channel, text, message }. Not retryable. Params: channel, ts, text? or blocks? (at least one required), attachments? (JSON).

params.channel: Channel id where the message lives (C... / G... / D... / M...).
params.ts: Timestamp of the message to edit ("1234567890.123456").
params.text: New plain text body. At least one of text/blocks must be provided.
params.blocks: New Slack Block Kit JSON string (will be parsed). Replaces existing blocks.
params.attachments: New attachments JSON string (legacy). Pass [] to clear.

delete-message.name: delete-message
delete-message.description: Delete a message. The token user must be author or workspace admin. Returns { channel, ts, deleted: true }. Not retryable. Params: channel, ts, asUser? (default true — deletes as the user; false impersonates the workspace).

params.channel: Channel id where the message lives.
params.ts: Timestamp of the message to delete.
params.asUser: Delete as the authenticated user (default true). Set false only if the token has admin scope.

get-permalink.name: get-permalink
get-permalink.description: Get a permanent URL for a message. Returns { channel, ts, permalink }. Idempotent, retryable. Params: channel, ts.

schedule-message.name: schedule-message
schedule-message.description: Schedule a message to be posted at a future unix-seconds timestamp. Returns { channel, scheduledMessageId, postAt }. Slack rejects postAt > 120 days ahead. Not retryable. Params: channel, text, postAt (unix seconds), blocks?, threadTs?, unfurlLinks (def true), unfurlMedia (def true).

params.postAt: Unix seconds when the message should post. Must be future and ≤120 days ahead.
params.blocks: Optional Slack Block Kit JSON string.
params.threadTs: Parent message ts for thread reply.

list-scheduled-messages.name: list-scheduled-messages
list-scheduled-messages.description: List pending scheduled messages for the authenticated user. Returns { messages: [{ id, channelId, postAt, postAtIso, text }], nextCursor, hasMore }. Retryable. Params: channel?, latest?, oldest? (unix-seconds bounds), limit (1-100, def 100), cursor?.

params.channel: Filter to a single channel id.
params.cursor: Pagination cursor from a previous call.

delete-scheduled-message.name: delete-scheduled-message
delete-scheduled-message.description: Cancel a scheduled message. Returns { channel, scheduledMessageId, deleted: true }. Not retryable. Params: channel, scheduledMessageId, asUser? (def true).

params.channel: Channel id where the message was scheduled.
params.asUser: Delete as the authenticated user (default true).

send-ephemeral.name: send-ephemeral
send-ephemeral.description: Post an ephemeral message visible only to one user in a channel. Returns { channel, user, messageTs }. Not retryable. Params: channel, user (recipient), text, blocks?, threadTs?.

params.user: User id of the recipient (U... / W...). Only they will see it.
params.threadTs: Parent message ts for ephemeral thread reply.

send-me-message.name: send-me-message
send-me-message.description: Send a /me action message (third-person italic in Slack UI). Returns { ts, channel }. Not retryable. Params: channel, text.

unfurl-link.name: unfurl-link
unfurl-link.description: Provide custom unfurl content for links posted in a message (replaces Slack's default preview). unfurls is a JSON map: {"https://your.url":{"blocks":[...],"text":"..."}}. Returns { channel, ts, unfurled: true }. Not retryable. Params: channel, ts, unfurls (JSON), userAuthRequired?, userAuthUrl?, userAuthMessage?.

params.channel: Channel id of the message that has the link.
params.userAuthRequired: Mark this unfurl as requiring user OAuth (Slack will show 'Sign in' button).
params.userAuthMessage: Message to show on sign-in prompt.

pin-message.name: pin-message
pin-message.description: Pin a message to a channel. Returns { channel, timestamp, pinned: true }. Idempotent (already_pinned not treated as error). Params: channel, timestamp.

unpin-message.name: unpin-message
unpin-message.description: Unpin a message. Returns { channel, timestamp, unpinned: true }. Idempotent (no_pin not treated as error). Params: channel, timestamp.

list-pins.name: list-pins
list-pins.description: List items pinned to a channel (messages and files). Returns { pins: [{ type, createdAt, createdBy, message? | file? }], count }. Retryable. Params: channel.

params.channel: Channel id whose pins to list.

add-bookmark.name: add-bookmark
add-bookmark.description: Add a bookmark to a channel (links shown in the channel header). Returns the curated bookmark. Not retryable. Params: channel, title, link (URL), emoji? (e.g. ':notebook:').

params.title: Display title.
params.link: URL the bookmark points to (http/https only).
params.emoji: Optional emoji shortcode for the bookmark icon.

remove-bookmark.name: remove-bookmark
remove-bookmark.description: Remove a channel bookmark by id. Returns { channel, bookmarkId, removed: true }. Not retryable. Params: channel, bookmarkId.

list-bookmarks.name: list-bookmarks
list-bookmarks.description: List bookmarks attached to a channel. Returns { bookmarks: [{ id, channelId, title, link, emoji, type, dateCreated, dateUpdated, rank }], count }. Retryable. Params: channel.

edit-bookmark.name: edit-bookmark
edit-bookmark.description: Edit an existing channel bookmark. Partial update. Returns the updated bookmark. Not retryable. Params: channel, bookmarkId, title?, link? (http/https), emoji?.

add-reaction.name: add-reaction
add-reaction.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message. Returns { channel, timestamp, name }. Idempotent (already_reacted raises BUSINESS_RULE). Params: channel, timestamp, name (no colons).

params.channel: Channel id where the message is.
params.name: Emoji name without colons (e.g. 'thumbsup', 'fire').

remove-reaction.name: remove-reaction
remove-reaction.description: Remove an emoji reaction from a message. Returns { channel, timestamp, name }. Idempotent (no_reaction raises BUSINESS_RULE). Params: channel, timestamp, name (no colons).

params.channel: Channel id where the message is.
params.name: Emoji name without colons (e.g. 'thumbsup').

get-reactions.name: get-reactions
get-reactions.description: Get reactions on a message or file. Provide EITHER (channel+timestamp) for a message OR (file) for a file. Returns { reactions: [{ name, count, users }], type, target }. Retryable. Params: channel?+timestamp? | file?, full (def true — include all reactors).

params.channel: Channel id (paired with timestamp for a message).
params.full: If true, all reactors are returned. Default true.

list-my-reactions.name: list-my-reactions
list-my-reactions.description: List all items the user has reacted to (messages and files). Returns { items, paging }. Retryable. Params: userId? (def authed), count (1-1000, def 100), page, full (def true).

list-users.name: list-users
list-users.description: List workspace users. Returns curated rows { id, name, realName, displayName, email, imageUrl, isBot, isAdmin, isOwner, deleted, tz } + nextCursor. Params: limit (1-200, def 100), cursor, includeDeleted (def false), includeBots (def true), fields?, includeRaw.

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 200, default 100.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Slack user objects. Default false.

get-user.name: get-user
get-user.description: Get a single user by id or email. Returns the curated user (id, name, realName, displayName, email, imageUrl, profile, tz). Provide exactly one of userId/email. Params: userId?, email?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.userId: Slack user id (U... / W...). Mutex with email.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Slack user object. Default false.

get-user-presence.name: get-user-presence
get-user-presence.description: Get presence for a Slack user. Returns { user, presence, online, autoAway, manualAway, connectionCount, lastActivity }. Params: userId.

get-user-profile.name: get-user-profile
get-user-profile.description: Get the full Slack profile for a user (status, custom_fields, image, phone, title, timezone). Returns curated profile. Retryable. Params: userId? (default: authed user), includeLabels (def false), includeRaw.

params.userId: User id (U... / W...). Omit to get the authenticated user's own profile.
params.includeLabels: Include custom field labels in the response. Default false.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Slack profile object. Default false.

update-user-profile.name: update-user-profile
update-user-profile.description: Update the authenticated user's Slack profile (status, name fields, phone, title, custom fields). Returns the updated profile object. Not retryable. Params: statusText?, statusEmoji?, statusExpiration? (unix seconds), realName?, displayName?, phone?, title?, customFields? (JSON map of field_id → {value, alt?}), userId? (admin-only).

params.statusText: Short status (≤100 chars). Pass empty string to clear.
params.statusEmoji: Emoji shortcode for status (e.g. ":coffee:"). Pass empty to clear.
params.statusExpiration: Unix seconds when the status auto-clears. 0 = never expire.
params.title: Job title.
params.customFields: JSON string mapping custom field ids to {value, alt?}. Example: '{"Xf01":{"value":"v"}}'
params.userId: Admin-only: target another user's profile (requires admin scope).

list-user-channels.name: list-user-channels
list-user-channels.description: List channels a user is a member of. Returns { channels, nextCursor, hasMore }. Retryable. Params: userId? (def authed), types? (csv: public_channel,private_channel,mpim,im), excludeArchived (def true), limit (1-1000, def 200), cursor?.

delete-user-photo.name: delete-user-photo
delete-user-photo.description: Delete the authenticated user's profile photo (replaces with default avatar). Returns { deleted: true }. Not retryable. No params.

get-user-identity.name: get-user-identity
get-user-identity.description: Get the authenticated user's basic identity from the OAuth context (minimum scope: identity.basic, optionally identity.email/avatar/team). Returns curated identity. Retryable. No params.

upload-file.name: upload-file
upload-file.description: Upload a local file to Slack and optionally share it. Returns the curated file (id, name, mimetype, size, permalink, thumbUrl). Path must resolve to an absolute path. Not retryable. Params: filePath, channels?[], title?, initialComment?, threadTs?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.filePath: Absolute path to the local file (≤100 MB).
params.channels: Slack channel ids to share to. Single id is fine.
params.title: Optional file title (defaults to basename).
params.initialComment: Optional comment posted alongside the file.
params.threadTs: Optional parent message ts to share inside a thread.
params.fields: Override default whitelist on the returned file.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Slack file object. Default false.

list-files.name: list-files
list-files.description: List uploaded files. Returns curated rows { id, name, title, mimetype, prettyType, size, user, urlPrivate, permalink, thumbUrl, createdAt } + paging. Params: channel?, user?, limit (1-100, def 20), page (def 1), tsFrom, tsTo, types? (CSV all|spaces|snippets|images|gdocs|zips|pdfs), fields?, includeRaw.

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 20.
params.tsFrom: Filter files created after this Unix timestamp.
params.tsTo: Filter files created before this Unix timestamp.
params.types: Comma-separated types from all, spaces, snippets, images, gdocs, zips, pdfs. Default all.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Slack file objects. Default false.

get-file.name: get-file
get-file.description: Get full info for a file (channels shared, permalinks, optional comments). Returns curated file + comments?[]. Retryable. Params: fileId (F...), includeComments (def false), includeRaw.

params.includeComments: Include comment list (legacy API). Default false.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Slack file object. Default false.

delete-file.name: delete-file
delete-file.description: Delete a file. The token user must be owner or workspace admin. Returns { fileId, deleted: true }. Not retryable. Params: fileId (F...).

get-upload-url.name: get-upload-url
get-upload-url.description: Step 1 of Slack's modern multi-step upload: get a pre-signed external URL + uploadId. PUT the file bytes to the URL, then call complete-upload with the uploadId. Use this for files >100MB or when progress tracking is needed. Returns { uploadUrl, fileId, length }. Params: filename, length (bytes), altTxt?, snippetType?.

params.length: File size in bytes (required by Slack).

complete-upload.name: complete-upload
complete-upload.description: Step 2 of the modern upload flow: after PUT-ing bytes to the uploadUrl from get-upload-url, call this with files=[{id, title?}] to finalize. Optionally share to a channel/thread with initialComment. Returns curated file(s). Not retryable. Params: files (JSON array), channelId?, initialComment?, threadTs?.

params.initialComment: Optional message attached to the share.

share-file-public.name: share-file-public
share-file-public.description: Make a file publicly accessible via URL (anyone with link can view, no login). Returns { fileId, permalinkPublic }. Not retryable. Params: fileId (F...).

revoke-file-public.name: revoke-file-public
revoke-file-public.description: Revoke a file's public URL (links via permalink_public stop working). Returns { fileId, revoked: true }. Not retryable. Params: fileId.

list-remote-files.name: list-remote-files
list-remote-files.description: List remote files (external storage references like Google Drive, Dropbox) registered with Slack. Returns { files, nextCursor, hasMore }. Retryable. Params: channel?, tsFrom?, tsTo?, limit (1-200, def 100), cursor?.

add-remote-file.name: add-remote-file
add-remote-file.description: Register an external file (e.g. Google Drive, Dropbox) with Slack so it's discoverable in search and share-able. Returns curated remote file. Not retryable. Params: externalId, externalUrl, title, fileType?, previewImage?, indexableFileContents?.

params.externalId: Unique id in the external provider.
params.externalUrl: URL to the file in the external provider.
params.title: Display title.
params.indexableFileContents: Plain text contents for Slack search indexing.

update-remote-file.name: update-remote-file
update-remote-file.description: Update metadata of a remote file (externalUrl, title, etc.). Provide externalId XOR fileId. Returns curated remote file. Not retryable. Params: externalId? | fileId? (one required), and any of externalUrl?, title?, fileType?, previewImage?, indexableFileContents?.

remove-remote-file.name: remove-remote-file
remove-remote-file.description: Remove a remote file reference from Slack (does not delete the file in the external provider). Provide externalId XOR fileId. Returns { removed: true }. Not retryable. Params: externalId? | fileId? (one required).

share-remote-file.name: share-remote-file
share-remote-file.description: Share an existing remote file to one or more channels. Provide externalId XOR fileId. Returns curated remote file. Not retryable. Params: channels (comma-separated channel ids), externalId? | fileId?.

get-remote-file.name: get-remote-file
get-remote-file.description: Get details of a remote file. Provide externalId XOR fileId. Returns curated remote file. Retryable. Params: externalId? | fileId?.

search-messages.name: search-messages
search-messages.description: Search messages workspace-wide. Supports Slack search syntax (in:#channel, from:@user, before/after). Returns curated hits { ts, channel, channelName, user, userName, text, permalink, score } + total + page. Params: query, sort? (score|timestamp), sortDirection? (asc|desc), count (1-100, def 20), page, highlight, fields?, includeRaw.

params.query: Slack search query (supports operators like in:#channel, from:@user).
params.sort: Sort by relevance or time. Default score.
params.count: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 20.
params.highlight: Highlight matching terms in returned text. Default false.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Slack search.matches[]. Default false.

search-files.name: search-files
search-files.description: Search files workspace-wide. Supports Slack search syntax (in:#channel, from:@user, type:pdf). Returns curated hits { id, name, title, mimetype, permalink, thumbUrl, score, createdAt } + total + page. Params: query, sort? (score|timestamp), sortDirection?, count (1-100, def 20), page, highlight, fields?, includeRaw.

params.query: Slack search query (supports operators like type:pdf, in:#channel).
params.sort: Sort by relevance or time. Default score.
params.count: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 20.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Slack search.files.matches[]. Default false.

get-team-info.name: get-team-info
get-team-info.description: Get the connected Slack workspace info. Returns { id, name, domain, emailDomain, iconUrl, enterpriseId, enterpriseName }. Params: fields?, includeRaw.

params.fields: Override default whitelist on the returned team.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Slack team object. Default false.

get-team-preferences.name: get-team-preferences
get-team-preferences.description: Get workspace policy preferences (locale, default channels, who can create/archive channels, message edit window, calls/huddles enabled). Returns curated preferences. Retryable. No params.

get-team-profile.name: get-team-profile
get-team-profile.description: Get the schema of custom user profile fields for the workspace. Returns { fields: [{ id, label, type, hint, isHidden, ordering, possibleValues }] }. Retryable. Params: visibility (def all).

get-access-logs.name: get-access-logs
get-access-logs.description: Get login audit trail for the workspace (paid plans only). Returns { logs, paging }. Retryable. Params: before? (unix seconds), count (1-1000, def 100), page.

params.before: Filter to logs before this unix timestamp.

get-integration-logs.name: get-integration-logs
get-integration-logs.description: Get integration audit trail (apps installed/uninstalled/scope changes). Paid plans only. Returns { logs, paging }. Retryable. Params: appId?, changeType? (added|removed|enabled|disabled|updated|expanded), serviceId?, user?, count (1-1000, def 100), page.

star-item.name: star-item
star-item.description: Save an item (message / file) to the user's saved items (stars). Provide EITHER (channel+timestamp) OR (file) OR (fileComment). Returns { type, target, starred: true }. Idempotent. Params: channel?+timestamp? | file? | fileComment?.

unstar-item.name: unstar-item
unstar-item.description: Remove an item from the user's saved items. Same exclusive-choice contract as star-item. Returns { type, target, unstarred: true }. Idempotent (no_pin not treated as error). Params: channel?+timestamp? | file? | fileComment?.

list-stars.name: list-stars
list-stars.description: List the user's saved items (stars). Returns { items, nextCursor, hasMore }. Retryable. Params: count (1-1000, def 100), cursor?.

list-emoji.name: list-emoji
list-emoji.description: List custom workspace emojis. Returns { emojis: [{ name, url, isAlias, aliasFor }], count }. Retryable. No params.

add-emoji.name: add-emoji
add-emoji.description: Add a custom workspace emoji. Provide EITHER url (new image) OR aliasFor (alias of existing emoji). Returns { name, isAlias, aliasFor?, ok: true }. Not retryable. Params: name, url? | aliasFor?.

params.name: Emoji name (no colons, lowercase, no spaces — e.g. 'teros').
params.url: URL of the image (PNG/JPG/GIF, max 128KB, square recommended).
params.aliasFor: Existing emoji name to alias (no colons).

remove-emoji.name: remove-emoji
remove-emoji.description: Remove a custom workspace emoji. Workspace admin only. Returns { name, removed: true }. Not retryable. Params: name (no colons).

set-dnd.name: set-dnd
set-dnd.description: Turn on Do Not Disturb for the authenticated user for N minutes. Returns { snoozeEnabled, snoozeEndtime, snoozeRemaining }. Not retryable. Params: numMinutes (1-1440).

params.numMinutes: How long to snooze (in minutes). Min 1, max 1440 (24h).

end-dnd.name: end-dnd
end-dnd.description: End the current snooze. Returns { snoozeEnabled: false }. Idempotent. No params.

get-dnd.name: get-dnd
get-dnd.description: Get DND status for a user. Returns { snoozeEnabled, snoozeEndtime, snoozeRemaining, nextDndStart, nextDndEnd }. Retryable. Params: userId? (default: authed user).

params.userId: User id (U... / W...). Omit for the authenticated user.

get-team-dnd.name: get-team-dnd
get-team-dnd.description: Get DND status for multiple users at once. users is a comma-separated user id list. Returns { users: [{ userId, snoozeEnabled, ... }] }. Retryable. Params: users (csv).

create-list.name: create-list
create-list.description: Create a Slack List (collaborative table). Returns curated list with schema. EXPERIMENTAL — Slack Lists API is still evolving (2024+). Params: name, description?, schema? (JSON array of {name, type}), todoMode (def false).

params.name: Display name.
params.todoMode: Enable todo mode (rows can be checked off). Default false.

update-list.name: update-list
update-list.description: Update list metadata or schema. Partial: only fields provided are updated. Returns curated list. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId, name?, description?, schema? (JSON), todoMode?.

delete-list.name: delete-list
delete-list.description: Delete a Slack List (and all its items). Returns { listId, deleted: true }. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId.

get-list.name: get-list
get-list.description: Get list details + schema. Returns curated list. Retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId.

list-list-items.name: list-list-items
list-list-items.description: List items (rows) in a Slack List with cursor pagination. Returns { listId, items, nextCursor, hasMore }. Retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId, limit (1-100, def 50), cursor?.

create-list-item.name: create-list-item
create-list-item.description: Add a row (item) to a Slack List. fields is a JSON object mapping column-id → value. Returns curated item. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId, fields (JSON).

params.fields: JSON object mapping column id to value. Example: '{"title":"Task X","due":"2026-05-20"}'

update-list-item.name: update-list-item
update-list-item.description: Update fields of a list item. fields is a JSON object — only the keys provided are updated. Returns curated item. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId, itemId, fields (JSON).

params.fields: JSON object — partial update of column values.

delete-list-item.name: delete-list-item
delete-list-item.description: Delete a list item. Returns { listId, itemId, deleted: true }. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId, itemId.

list-list-fields.name: list-list-fields
list-list-fields.description: List the column schema of a Slack List as individual field objects. Returns { fields, count }. Retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId.

create-list-field.name: create-list-field
create-list-field.description: Add a new column to a Slack List schema. Returns the created field. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId, name, type (text|number|date|user|checkbox|select|multi_select|url|email), required (def false).

update-list-field.name: update-list-field
update-list-field.description: Rename a list column or toggle required. type is immutable. Returns the updated field. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId, fieldId, name?, required?.

delete-list-field.name: delete-list-field
delete-list-field.description: Delete a column from a Slack List schema (all values in items are also dropped). Returns { listId, fieldId, deleted: true }. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId, fieldId.

create-canvas.name: create-canvas
create-canvas.description: Create a standalone Slack Canvas (rich-text doc). Returns curated canvas. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: title, contentMarkdown? (initial content).

edit-canvas.name: edit-canvas
edit-canvas.description: Edit a canvas with a list of changes. Operations: insert_at_start|insert_at_end (no section_id) | insert_before|insert_after|replace|delete (section_id REQUIRED — use canvases.sections.lookup). All except delete also require document_content {type:'markdown',markdown:string}. Returns curated canvas. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL.

params.changes: JSON array of operations. Example: '[{"operation":"insert_at_end","document_content":{"type":"markdown","markdown":"# New section"}}]' or '[{"operation":"replace","section_id":"S123","document_content":{"type":"markdown","markdown":"updated"}}]'

delete-canvas.name: delete-canvas
delete-canvas.description: Delete a canvas. Returns { canvasId, deleted: true }. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: canvasId.

create-channel-canvas.name: create-channel-canvas
create-channel-canvas.description: Create a canvas attached to a channel (visible to all members). Returns curated canvas. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: channelId, title?, contentMarkdown?.

start-stream.name: start-stream
start-stream.description: Start a streaming message (AI responses delivered chunk-by-chunk live). Returns { streamId, channel }. Use append-stream + stop-stream to complete. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: channel, threadTs?, recipientTeamId?.

append-stream.name: append-stream
append-stream.description: Append a chunk of content to an active streaming message. Returns { streamId, appended: true }. Not retryable (each call appends — retry would duplicate content). EXPERIMENTAL. Params: streamId, content.

stop-stream.name: stop-stream
stop-stream.description: Stop a streaming message (flushes final state). Returns { streamId, stopped: true }. Idempotent (stream already stopped not treated as error). EXPERIMENTAL. Params: streamId.

add-call.name: add-call
add-call.description: Register a call (external provider) with Slack. Returns curated call. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: externalUniqueId, joinUrl, desktopAppJoinUrl?, externalDisplayId?, title?, users? (JSON array), dateStart? (unix seconds).

params.externalUniqueId: Unique id for the call in the external provider (must be stable).
params.title: Call title.
params.dateStart: Unix seconds when the call started.

end-call.name: end-call
end-call.description: Mark a call as ended. Returns { callId, ended: true }. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: callId, duration? (seconds).

update-call.name: update-call
update-call.description: Update call metadata (title or join URLs). Returns curated call. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: callId, title?, joinUrl?, desktopAppJoinUrl?.

get-call.name: get-call
get-call.description: Get call details (participants, duration, status). Returns curated call. Retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: callId.

add-call-participants.name: add-call-participants
add-call-participants.description: Add participants to an active call. users is a JSON array of {slackId|externalId, displayName?, avatarUrl?}. Returns { callId, added: count }. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL.

remove-call-participants.name: remove-call-participants
remove-call-participants.description: Remove participants from a call. users is a JSON array of {slackId|externalId}. Returns { callId, removed: count }. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL.

params.users: JSON array of participants to remove.

list-connect-invites.name: list-connect-invites
list-connect-invites.description: List pending Slack Connect (cross-workspace) channel invites. Returns { invites, nextCursor, hasMore }. Retryable. Params: count (1-100, def 50), cursor?, teamId?.

invite-shared.name: invite-shared
invite-shared.description: Send Slack Connect invite to share a channel with external user(s). Provide emails (csv) OR userIds (csv). Returns { channel, inviteId, link }. Not retryable. Params: channel, emails? | userIds?, externalLimited (def false).

params.userIds: Comma-separated user ids (if user already in Slack).
params.externalLimited: Limit invite to external-only (no internal accidental clicks). Default false.

accept-shared-invite.name: accept-shared-invite
accept-shared-invite.description: Accept a Slack Connect invite (joins the shared channel into the user's workspace). Provide inviteId XOR channelId. Returns { channelId, inviteId }. Not retryable. Params: channelName (local name for the joined channel), inviteId? | channelId?, isPrivate (def false), freeTrial (def false).

params.channelName: Local name for the channel after joining.
params.isPrivate: Set channel as private. Default false.
params.freeTrial: Use Slack Connect free trial. Default false.

decline-shared-invite.name: decline-shared-invite
decline-shared-invite.description: Decline a Slack Connect channel invite. Returns { inviteId, declined: true }. Not retryable. Params: inviteId, targetTeam? (override target team id).

approve-shared-invite.name: approve-shared-invite
approve-shared-invite.description: Approve a Slack Connect channel invite as a workspace admin (when admin approval is required by policy). Returns { inviteId, approved: true }. Not retryable. Params: inviteId, targetTeam? (Enterprise Grid).

revoke-auth.name: revoke-auth
revoke-auth.description: Revoke the current OAuth token (logs the user out of this Slack workspace from Teros). Returns { revoked: true }. Not retryable — destructive. Params: test (def false — set true to validate without actually revoking).

params.test: If true, simulate without revoking (for validation). Default false.

list-auth-teams.name: list-auth-teams
list-auth-teams.description: List Slack workspaces the current token has access to (relevant in Enterprise Grid). Returns { teams, nextCursor, hasMore }. Retryable. Params: includeIcon (def false), limit (1-100, def 100), cursor?.

name: Slack
description: Full Slack workspace integration: channels, messages, threads, reactions, files, users, search, and presence. Uses Slack Web API with OAuth 2.0.

changelog.notes: Initial release — send and read messages, manage channels, threads, files, reactions, users, and search
